name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back with arms extended toward the ceiling and hips and knees bent at right angles.
Exhale gently and press your lower back firmly against the floor to brace your core.
Slowly reach one arm behind you while extending the opposite leg toward the floor.
Draw both limbs back to center with control and alternate sides.
tips: Shorten your reach if your lower back starts to arch off the floor.
Move slowly and keep the stationary arm and knee still over your torso.
